about: USB loader packages the owner admitted for the beta without new qualification, each bound to one module version and one package SHA-256. A module that retains an earlier version's evidence (tests.retainedEvidence) keeps every other package row frozen; only this exact row in src/engine/assets/octatrack-module-packages.json is set aside (scripts/retained-evidence.mjs). It is no hardware or emulator evidence.

waivers.approval: repeat98, 14 Oct 2026: open every module for the beta with the hardware evidence waived per version; Tape Echo ships its USB package through this hash-bound waiver.
repeat98, 15 Oct 2026: roll Tape Echo back from 0.1.4 to the 0.1.3 code as 0.1.5; its USB package is byte-identical to the waived 0.1.3 package.
